software.engine_image: qwen3-engine:25.10 (rebuilt 2026-07-07 with the optimization commits below)
engine_optimizations_included: ff8dc4f feat(export): CP 15-stage unroll keeps KV cache (~3x decode compute reduction)
c9c63c2 perf(engine): CUDA-graph decode replay (eliminates ~2700 kernel launches/step of CPU cost)
dd647be fix(engine): batch KV gather arena-ized (removes up-to-7.5GiB transient allocation per eager decode step)
d5741b6 fix(triton): ServerTimingAccumulator wiring + end->done terminal event unification
b80cf45 perf(engine): batched burst admission + Phase-1 per-slot tax elimination (c2w state arenas)
2a9578b perf(engine,gateway): c2w KV sliding window pooled per slot + serving hot-path slimming (async logging, orjson, gRPC chunk coalescing, uvloop)
a8e7274 perf(gateway): VAD-disabled sessions bypass the per-chunk int16 round-trip (also removes a hidden 15-bit quantization for pcm_f32)

dataset_provenance.engine_rows: collected 2026-07-07 on the engine build above (includes b80cf45/2a9578b/a8e7274); trials engine-01..03
dataset_provenance.triton_rows: retained from the 2026-07-06 dataset (engine core WITHOUT b80cf45/2a9578b/a8e7274); trials triton-01..03. The Triton BLS path wraps the same engine core, so the engine-side commits would improve it too -- its rows OVERSTATE current Triton latency and are kept only as the last measured reference.
dataset_provenance.note: raw_requests.csv = one representative engine trial (engine-01, 2026-07-07) + one representative Triton trial (triton-01, 2026-07-06)

metric_semantics_change.prefill_ms: As of b80cf45 (batched burst admission), prefill_started/prefill_completed bracket the whole batched admission pass (slot allocation + batched prefix-cache restore + batched suffix embed for every session admitted in that pass), not one session's own suffix compute. Under burst load prefill_ms therefore reads as tens of ms per session (engine rows) even though per-session GPU work is unchanged; at concurrency 1 the pass contains a single session and the value is comparable to the old semantics (~1ms). Triton rows predate the change and use the old per-session semantics. prefill_ms values are NOT comparable across the two datasets at load.

model.note: Full-bf16 engine. cp=bf16 validated hallucination-free on the internal 0701 checkpoint (0/100 deterministic probe; see docs/dev/investigation/streaming_hallucination.md). Re-probed 0/100 on 2026-07-07 immediately before this dataset was collected (runs=100, duration min 9.04s / median 10.08s / max 10.72s).

engine_profile.note: batch=128 selected automatically by the export-aware profile sizing (raw capacity ~141 lanes on this 32GiB card). The batch profile is a TEST VARIABLE, not a hardware ceiling -- see the report's 'Batch profile as a variable' section.

benchmark_request.speaker: Serena
benchmark_request.text: 你好，欢迎使用 Qwen3-TTS 语音合成系统，这是一段用于压测的示例文本。
benchmark_request.note: Fixed text/speaker across every request: isolates protocol/concurrency effects, and pins the run to a ~100% prefix-cache-hit regime (verified: cache_hit=True on 100% of measured rows). All prefill numbers are cache-hit (suffix-only) prefill.

isolation.policy: single-service: Triton container stopped during engine-path trials, engine container stopped during Triton trials
isolation.why: at batch=128 the engine alone holds ~29-30 GiB; the two services cannot coexist on this card, and co-residency would contaminate memory headroom and timing

tooling.harness: tools/validation/perf_matrix_sdk.py (built on the qwen3tts client SDK)
tooling.summarizer: tools/validation/summarize_perf_matrix.py (per trial), pooled across trials with identical aggregation logic

trial_design.aggregation_note: summary CSVs pool every recorded row of a group, including the phase=warmup rounds (same aggregation as the 2026-07-06 dataset, so cross-dataset deltas are apples-to-apples); warmup rows shift level-1 averages by well under 1 ms and high-concurrency averages by ~1%. Filter raw_requests.csv on phase=measure to exclude them.

server_ttft_single_stream_warm_ms.basis: server_session_create_to_first_raw_audio_ms from the done-event meta (same basis as the historical '13ms' claim), re-measured 2026-07-07 on this engine build

burst_ramp_decomposition.tool: workspace/ttft_ramp_decompose.py, 128 concurrent sessions, shared gRPC channel, warm engine
burst_ramp_decomposition.note: per-stage table in the report's 'Where burst TTFT goes' section
